title: Create Rocketjump
description: Create based modpack with greatly performance and with many additions
body:
# **🚀 Create Rocketjump: Flight and Firepower**

 **Welcome to Create Rocketjump — an industrial-combat modpack where large-scale engineering meets adrenaline and interactive physics.**
 
 The main purpose of this project is to allow players to build massive flying factories, arm them with heavy artillery, and survive in a challenging world where enemies constantly grow stronger. Stop building static factories — it's time to take them to the skies!
  
###    **⚙️ Main Features:**
-   ✈️ Realistic Physics and Transportation
 Powered by the highly anticipated Create Aeronautics, Create Propulsion: Simulated, and Unseaworthy, you are no longer bound to the ground. Design fully functional airships, planes, trains, and naval vessels with interactive, block-by-block physics. Your entire factory can now travel the world with you!
-   🏭 Advanced Industry  
 This pack significantly expands the base Create experience. Create: The Factory Must Grow (TFMG) introduces oil refining and heavy steel production, Create: Power Grid provides electricity, while Create: Connected and Create Stuff 'N Additions offer new tools for complex automation.
-   💥 Warfare and Survival
 The name Rocketjump speaks for itself. The world won't stay safe for long: the Hostile Mobs Improve Over Time mod forces monsters to evolve and scale in difficulty. To survive, you will need the firearms from Create: Gunsmithing and the massive naval artillery from Create Big Cannons. Arm your flying fortresses to the teeth!
- 🗺️ Aesthetics, Cooking, and Exploration
 Even in times of war, you need to eat and rest. Navigate the world using the vintage-style Antique Atlas 4. Decorate your bases and ships with Create: Interiors and Create: Design n' Decor. Meanwhile, Farmer's Delight combined with Create Ratatouille allows you to fully automate the production of culinary masterpieces.
